ms.promise: User-friendly interface for executing long position strategies.
ms.criteria:
・Users can initiate and manage long positions through a single, intuitive interface.
・Latest data feeds provide accurate information on asset prices, lending rates, and position health.
ms.report:
・Video: link
・Screenshot: main page, deposit
・Test link: https://interface-git-long-short-minswap.vercel.app/margin 
・Environment: Testnet Preview

We changed the technical approach from using the user's wallet to a non-custodial wallet called Nitro wallet. This wallet is unique and can be accessed by the user only (mapping with the root wallet). Users need to sign a tx first to create the wallet and then deposit into the Nitro wallet before making any positions. This approach will cost users 1 time signning transaction for the whole session, a better UX. 
P/s: Due to changing the approach + we need to complete 2 milestones at the same time. So the timeline was delayed a bit
